cards.answer: Xin Zhao is a fighter/tank who charges into enemies and uses empowered attacks to knock them up. His attacks and spear strikes emphasize physical damage and AD scaling, while his ultimate blocks damage from champions outside its circle.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance, dodge his spear thrust, and save damage while his ultimate blocks attacks from outside the circle.

cards.counterplay: Respect his extended reach when marked, and create distance after he charges.

cards.answer: Once Crescent Guard is learned, his basic attacks and Audacious Charge can mark enemy champions as Challenged. On activation, it deals physical damage to nearby enemies based partly on their current health, knocking back and briefly stunning enemies that are not Challenged. Xin Zhao then temporarily blocks damage from enemy champions outside his circle, including their ongoing or delayed damage if they are outside when it applies.
cards.counterplay: Save damage while outside his protective circle, and watch for him to separate allies from the Challenged target.
